observations.test: G03 confirmation control separates local response, actual delivery, differences, nonresponse and required-positive limitations
observations.action: independently checked recipient and reply route through bounded local response, manual dispatch evidence, actual exception evaluation and independent conclusion
observations.observed: Repeating local link generation revokes its predecessor without increasing confirmed subjects. The respondent confirms the exact declared scope; receipt alone is not acceptance and replay fails. Actual manual dispatch and direct response are separate. Mismatched amounts and unsupported management-forwarded replies fail. A necessary positive response cannot be replaced by an unsupported favorable conclusion. Management refusal retains actual reasons, implications and the next owner. Unsupported negative-only conditions and a revoked issuer deny further eligibility. No external mail or bank identity verification is claimed.
